lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in a semi-regular grid; anterior spots are smaller and more densely clustered, while posterior flank spots are larger and organized into distinct vertical columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot alignments, with the highest luminance nodes occurring at these intersection points on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) visible both attached to the ventral-lateral skin and swimming in the immediate proximity below the shark.
